title: Weight: Kilograms and Grams
seo_title: Weight – Primary 4 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Add and subtract weights in kilograms and grams; multiply and divide weights by whole numbers; estimate weights. (summary of the NERDC Primary 4 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 4 maths worksheets on weight: converting kilograms and grams, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing weights, reading scales and estimating weights. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 1 kg = 1,000 g. 2 kg 350 g = 2,350 g.
  • To calculate, change to grams, work it out, then change back to kg and g.
  • Heavy things (people, bags of rice) are weighed in kg; light things (an egg, a pencil) in g.

Examples

Example

4 kg 600 g − 1 kg 850 g

4,600 g − 1,850 g = 2,750 g

Answer: 2 kg 750 g

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
1 kg = 100 g1 kg = 1,000 g.
Reading the wrong scale marksFind what one small mark is worth first.
Forgetting to regroup1,450 g = 1 kg 450 g.
